blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon on Thursday dismissed reports that he would return as the secretary of the Department of Transportation (DOTr). Dizon made the statement when asked to comment on circulating reports of Cabinet revamp in which he would be tasked to lead the DOTr once again. “Kayo naman puro kayo tsismis eh. Hindi totoo yan,” Dizon told reporters in an interview after conducting an inspection of the Maysan Road in Valenzuela City with Mayor Wes Gatchalian. (You’re all for gossip, that is not true.)
